name: Lemony Orzo Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil, plus extra for drizzling
Parmesiano-Reggiano cheese, freshly grated on a microplane
radicchio, cored and very finely diced

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, whisk to combine vinegar, lemon juice and zest, garlic, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Slowly whisk in oil until emulsified; set aside.

In a large saucepan, bring 2 quarts water to boil. Add orzo and remaining 2 teaspoons salt and cook, stirring often, until fully tender, about 2 minutes past the al dente stage. Drain orzo and transfer to a rimmed baking sheet, then quickly toss with 2 tablespoons prepared dressing. Let cool completely on sheet pan, about 15 minutes.
Add Pecorino, radicchio, chickpeas, basil, banana peppers, and cooled orzo to large bowl with remaining dressing and toss to thoroughly combine. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Let salad sit at room temperature for 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld. Serve, drizzled with extra olive oil, or transfer to the refrigerator if serving later.

schema_metadata.keywords: pasta salad recipe, lemony orzo recipe, lemony orzo pasta salad recipe

description: This easy orzo pasta salad delivers bold flavor with minimal effort, thanks to a lemony vinaigrette, creamy chickpeas, and just the right amount of bitterness from radicchio.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 1 hr 10 min.

Make-ahead and storage: Salad can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 3 days. Stir and allow salad to come to room temperature before serving.
author: Leah Colins
